# Used Container

> Live aggregator for shipping container construction — container homes, cargotecture, adaptive reuse, and used-container buying — plus direct, sourced answers to shipping-market questions and a price-range calculator. Refreshed automatically every 6 hours.

## Sources
- Used Conex (YouTube) — used container walkarounds, sizing guides, buying advice

## Tools
- [Price Calculator](https://containers.snarkyalma.com/calculator/) — price ranges by size (20ft / 40ft / 40ft HC), condition (new / cargo-worthy / some dings / as-is), and per-mile delivery
- [Answers](https://containers.snarkyalma.com/answers/) — sourced Q&A pages: 40ft China–US cost structure, detention & demurrage, port congestion signals, 2027 container price direction, tradelane research method

## Adding a source
Edit `feeds.txt` — one line per feed:
`Feed Name|https://example.com/feed.xml|residential,commercial,diy,forsale,design|#badgecolor`
Commit and push; the next cron run picks it up.

### Optional: Google Alerts keyword feed
1. Go to google.com/alerts while logged into any Google account.
2. Query: "shipping container" AND ("repurposed" OR "upcycled" OR "cargotecture" OR "container home" OR "adaptive reuse")
3. Show options → Deliver to → RSS feed → Create Alert.
4. Copy the feed URL it gives you and add it to `feeds.txt` as a new line.
